## How to test

## Checklist
- [ ] No user data (audio, text, clips) leaves the device. See docs/PRIVACY.md
- [ ] No new network origins, or the CSP and an ADR are updated
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / e2e)
- [ ] Accessibility checked (keyboard, screen reader, axe)
- [ ] Strings go through i18n
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated under Unreleased
- [ ] ADR added if this is a significant technical decision
